data.text:
Nisar Gafar Basti vs The State Of Maharashtra on 29 July, 2024 
Author: Shivkumar Dige
Bench: Shivkumar Dige
 1
 1280.24Aba
 In The High Court Of Judicature At Bombay
 Bench At Aurangabad
 17 Anticipatory Bail Appln No. 1280 Of 2024
 Irfan @ Bablu Mainoddin Pathan
 Versus
 The State Of Maharashtra 
 ... 
 Advocate for Applicant : Mr.S.D.Kunte
 App for Respondent-State : Mr.N.B.Patil
 ...
 And
 Anticipatory Bail Appln No. 1281 Of 2024 
 Nisar S/O.Gafar Basti
 Versus 
 The State Of Maharashtra 
 ... 
 Advocate for Applicant : Mr.S.D.Kunte
 App for Respondent-State : Mr.N.B.Patil
 ... 
 Coram : Shivkumar Dige, J.
 Date : 29.07.2024 
P.C. :
1] Heard.  Issue notice to the respondents in both applications, returnable on 8th August, 2024. The learned APP waives notice on behalf the respondent-State. 
2] In the event of arrest of the applicants in connection with Crime No.378/2024 registered with Ahmedpur Police Station, Tq.Ahmedpur, District Latur, for the offence punishable under Sections 188, 272, 273, 328 of 1280.24ABA the Indian Penal Code and Section 59 of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006, they be released on anticipatory bail on executing personal bond of Rs.20,000/- each with one surety in the like amount by each of them. Applicants shall attend the concerned police station as and when required and shall co-operate in the investigation.
